name: Barrow Deeps
notes: The prison that held Illidan for 10,000 years, now opened: descend to find out what happened to the other prisoners and how the wardens plan to contain the threat.
tips: Three entrances: Mount Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold (unconfirmed whether each leads to a different wing)
Sonya Darkhallow appears to be the final boss

name: Hyjal Summit
notes: After Archimonde's defeat, at the summit of Mount Hyjal beside Nordrassil. Several paths through ruins above and below ground converge on the final encounters.
tips: The Wild King appears to be the final boss
May be split across a couple of nights, like Karazhan
A Legendary has been teased for this raid

name: Onyxia's Lair
strategy: Onyxia: a three-phase fight with lots of fire: stack fire resistance beforehand
unlock: Drakefire Amulet attunement chain (almost the same as Classic)
tips: Loot is expected to differ a lot from Classic
